snippet.title: Hyper Tanks - Skirmish Gameplay Trailer [Deathmatch / Capture the Flag]
snippet.description:
Watch gameplay of two complete Skirmish matches back to back in Hyper Tanks. The first match is the Deathmatch game mode, the second is Capture the Flag, both played against bots.
Wishlist Hyper Tanks on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2615150/Hyper_Tanks/

Hyper Tanks is an arcade-style arena shooter where shots bounce off walls! Choose from various tank classes, beat challenging solo & co-op campaigns and battle your friends in frantic multiplayer modes! Dodge incoming fire, collect powerups and deploy special weapons to survive this action-packed mayhem!
